answer:
I made the page for "Stocks I watch", but it can't fetch live prices from Yahoo Finance. Pages run in a sandbox with no network access, so that call isn't possible. A page that tried to make one would be refused.

Instead, I added an empty **Last price** column to your table. The page shows an input for each stock. When you type a price, it's saved to that column in the note. The page then shows each stock's profit or loss in amount and percent, plus a total with the percent return on what you invested.

I didn't add any prices, so the profit figures stay blank until you enter some. The totals add the numbers as they are, with no currency conversion. VOLV-B is probably in SEK, so the total mixes currencies.

If you want live prices, I can update the Last price column from here whenever you ask. I'd need the prices from you, because I can't look them up either.
